title: settings_changed
description: One change in a setting the loop runs on: which setting, its old and new value, the layer the new value came from and who changed it. Count one per fact (the once key, such as settings/maxInFlightIssues/mvb4ci14). The loop writes it (rule N1): each acting pass compares its settings snapshot with the one it kept and logs one event for every setting that differs.

key.description: The canonical leaf of the setting, such as maxInFlightIssues, stateTimeoutMs.design or derived.gateConcurrency.

old_value.description: The value before the change, any JSON; null when it was unset.

new_value.description: The value after the change, any JSON; null when it is now unset.

layer.description: The source of the new value; null for a derived value.

who.description: Who made the change: a person, the judge (an operation change), the repo (its own config) or a plugin default change.

fact.description: The once key of the change, such as settings/maxInFlightIssues/mvb4ci14.

detail.description: A short note on the change.
